symptoms: 'SettingsInterval' is not a member type of class 'GlanceSDK.Glance'
likely_causes: Using unqualified SettingsInterval or wrong module prefix; with Default UI the type must be GlanceDefaultUI.SettingsInterval
Copying a snippet that omits the module prefix
In 7.2: fetchSettingsInterval was removed from initVisitor and setVisitorParams
troubleshooting.resolution: With Default UI use GlanceDefaultUI.SettingsInterval. Examples: fetchSettingsInterval: GlanceDefaultUI.SettingsInterval = .never, or .never / .always / .repeating(3600) as argument (type inferred). Do not use SettingsInterval alone or Glance.SettingsInterval.

version_notes.7.1: Use GlanceDefaultUI.SettingsInterval for setVisitorParams and GlanceCore.SettingsInterval for Glance.initVisitor. Do not use SettingsInterval alone or Glance.SettingsInterval.
version_notes.7.2: In 7.2, setVisitorParams and initVisitor no longer have fetchSettingsInterval. To enable remote settings when using Default UI, call Glance (Core) directly: Glance.enableSettings(isEnabled: true) for 1-hour refresh, or Glance.setSettingsAPIRefreshInterval(refreshInterval:) for a custom interval (e.g. GlanceRefreshInterval(intervalInHours: -1) to disable).

likely_causes: Missing or incorrect Glance account / group configuration
troubleshooting.resolution: Call setVisitorParams with valid GlanceVisitorInitParams (groupid from Glance admin, non-zero) before start(). Ensure app has network permission and can reach Glance services. Check onError for EventStartSessionFailed or EventInvalidParameter. Sample app: GlanceManager.setVisitorParams then startSession; TestAppViewModel.startSession() builds params and calls GlanceManager.shared.setVisitorParams(...) then startSession(...).

likely_causes: Delegate set after start() or startHostedSession()
Delegate instance deallocated (e.g. weak or local object)
troubleshooting.resolution: Call GlanceDefaultUI.setDelegate(self) before starting a session or hosted session. Keep the delegate instance alive: use a view model or controller that is retained (e.g. owner holds strong reference). Set delegate in init() (e.g. TestAppViewModel) or in onAppear (e.g. HostedView, TestAppView) so it is set before the user taps Start. If using tabs, set delegate when the tab appears (HostedView.onAppear calls viewModel.setDelegate()).

likely_causes: Invalid or missing visitorid when using Presence
setVisitorParams not called with same params after setPresence(true)
troubleshooting.resolution: Use a stable visitorid (e.g. from CRM) in GlanceVisitorInitParams. Call setPresence(true) and setVisitorParams with the same params (sample: TestAppViewModel.onPresenceTapped() calls setPresence then setVisitorParams with visitorid). Check network and that Presence is enabled for your Glance group. Implement onError and filter EventPresenceConnectFail; consider showing user-facing message. presenceTimeoutExpired() is called if connection times out.

symptoms: Agent cannot start hosted session from app
Login failed when starting hosted session
likely_causes: Account not allowed to start hosted sessions
Wrong server URL if using custom server
troubleshooting.resolution: Verify Glance credentials and that the account has permission to start hosted sessions. Always show errorMessage to the user when hostedSessionDidEnd(errorMessage:) is called with non-empty errorMessage (sample: HostedViewModel sets showAlertDialog = true and HostedView shows Alert with Constants.dialogErrorTitle). Check onError for EventLoginFailed. Use get_file_by_path for HostedViewModel.swift and HostedView.swift.

symptoms: Crash or unexpected behavior after passing params
likely_causes: Invalid input (e.g. empty key when required, invalid video mode)
Wrong type or nil where required
troubleshooting.resolution: Review GlanceError.message and ensure all required params are set and valid. For start(), use a valid GlanceVideoMode (VideoOff, VideoSmallVisitor, VideoLargeVisitor, VideoSmallMultiway, VideoLargeMultiway). For setVisitorParams, ensure groupid is set and from Glance admin. For hosted session, ensure username and password are non-empty.

symptoms: Action not allowed in current state
start() or startHostedSession() has no effect
likely_causes: Calling start() or startHostedSession() when already in session
Calling endSession when no session active
Calling SDK methods in wrong order (e.g. start before setVisitorParams)
troubleshooting.resolution: Ensure call order: setVisitorParams then start() (or setPresence then setVisitorParams for Presence). Track session state via delegate (sessionAgentConnected, sessionEnded) before starting a new session. For hosted session, check isHostedSessionActive (or equivalent) before startHostedSession; call stopHostedSession before starting again if needed.

symptoms: Video preview black or not starting
Session with video fails or agent cannot see visitor video
troubleshooting.resolution: Only needed when using video. Add NSCameraUsageDescription to Info.plist (e.g. 'Glance wants to use your camera'). Request AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess(for: .video) before starting a session with video. If not authorized, show an in-app alert and direct user to Settings. If not using video, do not add camera or microphone permissions. Sample: TestAppView.onAppear checks authorizationStatus, requests access if .notDetermined, sets showAlert if !authorized and shows Alert with message about camera permission.

likely_causes: Network slow or unreachable during init
Server or firewall blocking Glance endpoints
troubleshooting.resolution: Increase or omit timeout in setVisitorParams (pass nil for no timeout). Ensure device has network access and can reach Glance services. Implement initTimeoutExpired() to inform the user (e.g. toast or alert). Sample app uses optional initTimeout in TestAppViewModel and passes it to setVisitorParams.

symptoms: Session key shown but agent never connects in time
likely_causes: Agent did not join within start-session timeout
Agent on wrong join page or wrong key
troubleshooting.resolution: Increase GlanceTimeout in start(key:timeout:videoMode:) or use nil timeout. Implement startTimeoutExpired() to show a message (e.g. 'Agent did not join in time'). Inform user to share key and have agent join at www.glance.net/agentjoin promptly.

likely_causes: Network delay or Presence server unreachable
troubleshooting.resolution: Increase or omit timeout in setPresence(_:timeout:maxConnectAttempts:). Implement presenceTimeoutExpired() to update UI (e.g. show 'Presence connection timed out'). Check onError for EventPresenceConnectFail.

symptoms: EventLoginFailed in onError when starting hosted session
hostedSessionDidEnd with error message about login
likely_causes: Account disabled or not licensed for hosted session
troubleshooting.resolution: Verify credentials and Glance account permissions with admin. Show GlanceError.message to user; consider directing to password reset or admin. Sample: HostedViewModel shows alert on hostedSessionDidEnd with non-empty errorMessage.

symptoms: Agent or visitor sees poor quality or disconnects
troubleshooting.resolution: SDK fires EventConnectionWarning and EventClearWarning. Implement onEvent(_ event: GlanceEvent) and surface these to the user (e.g. banner 'Connection unstable'). Suggest stable Wi‑Fi or disabling VPN. Sample app logs events in TestAppViewModel.onEvent.

symptoms: EventJoinFailed in onError on agent side
troubleshooting.resolution: Ensure agent uses the exact key shown to the visitor and joins before session or key expires. Verify agent has join permission for the group. Visitor should share key over voice or secure channel; agent goes to www.glance.net/agentjoin.

Use URL https://gitlab.com/glance-sdk-public/glance-default-ui-ios-releases and a valid version. Get the latest version via get_version_info(platform='ios', repo='default_ui') or get_requirements('ios') (use requirements.dependencies version). GlanceSDK is a dependency and resolves automatically. If using Xcode, try File > Packages > Reset Package Caches. For local package, ensure path points to cloned repo root.

likely_causes: Another window or view covering dialogs
Delegate not set so Default UI may not advance
Session flow not started (start not called or failed)
Presenting view controller not in window hierarchy
troubleshooting.resolution: Default UI presents dialogs via its own window. Ensure you called start() or started hosted session and that no custom UI is blocking. Set delegate so you can confirm sessionConnected and receivedSessionCode are called. Check onError for failures before dialog would show.

symptoms: Default UI still shows default English
troubleshooting.resolution: Default UI loads from main bundle first, then module bundle. Add keys to your app's Localizable.strings (in your target) or create en.lproj (and others) in your app bundle with the same keys as in GlanceLocalizedStringsConstants. Key names match the constants (e.g. GLANCE_DEFAULT_UI_START_DIALOG_TITLE). See flow localization and README Localization section.

likely_causes: View not in hierarchy when session is active
Mask added after session started and view not visible
WebView: GlanceMaskContentController not set before WKWebView creation
WebView in tab: isHidden not set to true when tab not visible
SwiftUI: masking wrong view (must mask underlying UIView)
troubleshooting.resolution: Call Glance.addMaskedView(view, withLabel: "Label") for views that are on screen during session. For SwiftUI, use .addMaskedView(withLabel:) modifier or wrap in UIHostingController and mask hostingController.view. For WebView: create GlanceMaskContentController(selectors, labels:), set on WKWebViewConfiguration.userContentController, create WKWebView with that config, then setWebView(maskingWebView). WebView masking displays while isHidden is false or the WebView is destroyed; when the WebView is in a tab or off-screen, set webView.isHidden = true when not visible and webView.isHidden = false when visible again. Sample: TestMaskingViewController (UIView), TestMaskingView (SwiftUI), TestWebViewController (WebView).

symptoms: WebView content visible to agent when tab switched
WebView masking still shows when tab is hidden
Agent sees WebView content when WebView is off-screen
likely_causes: WebView kept in memory (e.g. in a tab) but isHidden not updated when tab or visibility changes
troubleshooting.resolution: WebView masking displays as long as the WebView's isHidden is false or the WebView is destroyed. When the WebView is removed from view or kept in memory (e.g. part of a tab), set webView.isHidden = true when it is no longer visible and webView.isHidden = false when it should be visible again. This ensures the agent does not see WebView content when the user switches away from the tab.

symptoms: Visitor video not visible to agent
Preview works but in-session video does not
likely_causes: Capture session stopped by app or OS
troubleshooting.resolution: Set params.video = true in GlanceVisitorInitParams before setVisitorParams. Use a video mode in start (VideoSmallVisitor, VideoLargeVisitor, VideoSmallMultiway, VideoLargeMultiway). Ensure camera permission granted and AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess called before start. Do not stop the capture session yourself; SDK manages it.

symptoms: Errors occur but no alert or feedback
likely_causes: UI not bound to show alert (e.g. showAlertDialog not observed)
troubleshooting.resolution: Implement onError(_ error: GlanceError) and set a flag or publish state so the UI shows an alert. Sample: TestAppViewModel sets errorCode = error.code.description, errorMessage = error.message, showAlertDialog = true; TestAppView has .alert(isPresented: $viewModel.showAlertDialog) with title and message. For hosted session also handle hostedSessionDidEnd(errorMessage:) with non-empty errorMessage.

likely_causes: Window or view not in hierarchy
troubleshooting.resolution: Ensure the view to be shared is in the active window hierarchy. For render mode, sample app uses Glance.setDrawViewHierarchy(true) when option 'drawViewInHierarchy' is selected. Check that no overlay is blocking the content. If app goes to background, SDK may show a mask (see GlanceLocalizedStringsConstants.backgroundPauseMaskLabel).

symptoms: Want to hide keyboard from share
troubleshooting.resolution: Call Glance.maskKeyboard(true) to show a mask over the keyboard (label from GlanceLocalizedStringsConstants.keyboardMaskLabel). Sample: TestAppView.onAppear calls Glance.maskKeyboard(true).

usage: Use get_troubleshooting(symptom_or_id) to find entries by symptom text or entry id. Each entry includes resolution, sample_ref (path in repo for get_file_by_path), related_flows, related_apis, and related_errors.
